overall: The AG resolved the complaint by informal action, finding the Board's July 27, 2016 notice sufficient because public bodies may act on any topic listed on a notice, so no violation occurred.

allegations.summary: Complainant alleged the board discussed and acted on a topic (changing its minutes-approval policy) that was not listed on the July 27, 2016 meeting notice.
allegations.key_passage: Based on the foregoing, we find that the Board's meeting notice was sufficient, and that the Board therefore did not violate the Open Meeting Law with respect to this allegation.
